race.comment: TANGO RHYTHM (7) ran over the top to score in a photo finish at this track and trip last time out, winning as the race favourite. She maps for a similar run this time around and drops in weight as she goes into a ratings race. Can make it three on the bounce. WESTERN IMPACT (4) never got into the race last time when settling back in the run and remaining well back. Suspect Faithfull will try something different today as his prior form was great. Can bounce back to his best form. BIG SHOTS (2) bolted in over 1425m at Broome last time out, scoring by 3.5L in dominant fashion as the race favourite. The form out of it has already stood up and he carries the same weight today. Can repeat the dose. BLOWIN' SMOKE (6) is better than he's shown his past couple and carries no weight today. Can improve. SOARING SOLO (3) is hard to knock on recent form and will be tough to run down.
